attributes.summary: Top-level intent: one person, many accounts (Google first) surfaced to AI assistants via a local MCP server owning its own token store; themes: core server, further providers, remote & distribution.

Core-server architecture: account registry (alias-routed, extra_info), secrets-apart token store (files 0600, keychain later), explicit account param + all-accounts fan-out, BYO OAuth client, core/transport split, read-only v1.
Milestone 1: operator chats with all his Gmail inboxes from Claude Code over stdio MCP - two+ real accounts, per-alias and fan-out search, full message read, surviving token refresh.

Executable-cold brief: TypeScript exfu-multiaccount package - config, registry, FileTokenStore, Google loopback OAuth (gmail.readonly), gmail search/read, MCP stdio server + CLI, vitest suite; exact commands and pass criteria pinned.

Accepted by operator (al) under the 2026-09-01 session carte-blanche grant; rulings recorded in-doc (Q1 Gmail-first, Q2 read-only v1, Q3 TypeScript). Same commit wires exfu delegation (settings hook, .exfu/providers.toml with APV capture provider) and lands the prior-art research report.
